cinet.name: Cinor 25mm f/1.8 (CINET)
cinet.description: A standard focal length lens for the H-16, listed by Paillard under Standard Lenses at $70.00 in the dealer price list of May 1967. Nothing else about it has been established here. The archive holds a Cinor 25mm f/0.95 and a Cinor 25mm f/1.4 RX, and this is neither of them.

lyset.name: Cinor 16mm f/2.8 (LYSET)
lyset.description: A wide angle lens for the H-16, listed by Paillard under Wide Angle Lenses at $59.50 in the dealer price list of May 1967, beside the Switar 10mm and 16mm. The archive has no other Cinor at this focal length.

pizar-12-5mm-f-1-9-1952.name: Pizar 12.5mm f/1.9
pizar-12-5mm-f-1-9-1952.description: An 8mm lens in standard A.S.A. mount, $95.75 in the Bolex retail price list of February 1952, where it sits between the Switar 12.5mm f/1.5 at $120.50 and the Lytar at $50.00. The same list prices an H-8 De luxe fitted with it at $413.75 and an L-8 outfit at $172.00, so it was a regular factory option rather than a rarity. The archive holds Pizars at 5.5mm, 25mm, 26mm and 50mm, but had none at 12.5mm.

catalogue.offeredFor: the Bolex H-8 and the L-8
